Terms & Conditions

Last updated: 2026

These Terms & Conditions govern the rental of disposal trailers from Ridgeway Rentals ("we", "us", or "our"). By submitting a booking request through https://ridgewayrentals.ca, calling us, or accepting delivery of a trailer, you agree to these terms.

Booking Requests

Submitting an online or phone request does not guarantee availability. A rental is only confirmed once a Ridgeway Rentals team member has confirmed your dates and trailer availability.

Delivery & Pickup

Delivery and pickup times are scheduled based on availability and access to your location. Please ensure there is adequate, clear space for safe placement of the trailer. Additional fees may apply for locations outside our standard service area.

Acceptable Materials

Only the materials discussed and approved at the time of booking may be placed in the trailer. Hazardous, prohibited, or regulated materials (such as chemicals, paints, tires, or asbestos) are not permitted. Additional charges may apply for prohibited items, overloading, or excess weight.

Rental Period

Your rental period begins on the confirmed drop-off date and ends on the confirmed pickup date. Requests to extend a rental should be made as early as possible and are subject to availability.

Payment

Rates are provided at the time of booking confirmation. Payment details will be collected prior to or at the time of delivery unless otherwise agreed.

Liability

While our trailers are designed to be driveway-safe, Ridgeway Rentals is not responsible for pre-existing damage to a customer's property. Customers are responsible for ensuring the placement area can support the trailer and its contents.

Changes to These Terms

We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. Continued use of our services after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

Contact Us

If you have questions about these Terms & Conditions, please contact us at sales@ridgewayrentals.ca or 365-925-0155.
